title.narrative: Improve Foundational Learning Outcomes - Southern Regions

description.narrative:
The project will improve foundational learning outcomes in response to the pressing learning crisis in Southern Ethiopia Regional State (SERS) and Southwest Ethiopia People's Region (SWEPR). The overall outcome of the proposed programme is to ensure that by 2027 the disadvantaged children in the primary school grades (1-6) in the targeted primary schools learns and achieves improved and meaningful learning outcomes. The project intend to support every child to learn by making effective instructional practice clear and doable. Key interventions will ensure that teachers deliver effective instruction in the classroom, contributing to learning with shared accountability among key education stakeholders to ensure every child learns.
Five major strategies will be used:
1) Developing and rolling out a context-specific and evidence-based learning approach through the TaRL approach 2) Strengthening the capacity of primary school teachers to use participatory, learner-centered, inclusive and gender-responsive pedagogy through both the pre-service and in-service models. 3) Provision of dignity kits, teaching and learning materials, including assistive devices for children with disabilities 4) Provision of school grants as seed funding to support school improvement plans 5) Strengthening shared ownership and accountability for improved teaching and student learning outcomes at the school, community and Woreda levels 6) Strengthening evidence generation to enhance evidence-based decision-making to continually improve learning achievement.
Full title of project is: The Modelling Accountability and Effective Instruction Programme to Improve Foundational Learning Outcomes in the Southern Ethiopia Regional State and Southwest Ethiopia People's Region 2024 - 2027
